title: AFL LIVE: Cats flip the script to snap Melbourne’s MCG winning streak
desc: Melbourne play Geelong Cats in round 20 of the 2026 AFL premiership season at the MCG, Melbourne at 7.40pm AEST. Seven, Kayo and Fox Footy are broadcasting the match live. Follow this live blog for minute-by-minute updates, scores, results, odds, squads, injury updates and start time. This blog will also include posts and news from Fremantle vs West Coast Eagles at Optus Stadium at 8.10pm.

title: Apply for Multicultural Arts Programme Grant - Ecosystem Development (Singapore)
desc: Deadline: 15-Sep-2026 The Multicultural Arts Programme Grant (Ecosystem Development) supports initiatives that strengthen Singapore’s multicultural arts ecosystem through research, capability building, cross-cultural engagement, and sector-wide development. The grant funds projects that create opportunities for artists, practitioners, educators, and communities to develop sustainable multicultural arts practices. The programme provides funding of up to $300,000 per project

title: Govt tables Vande Mataram Bill in Rajya Sabha amid Oppn sloganeering: What does it propose?
desc: The proposal in the bill makes desecration of or disrespect toward the country's national symbols – including the national flag, the Constitution, and the national anthem – a criminal offence, carrying a punishment of up to three years’ imprisonment.
